title: ak capacity --json (capacity-v1)
description: One account's headroom and a verdict, computed with ak pick's arithmetic (pick.evaluate: the smallest free share of the governing windows, a 10% reserve on windows of 7 days or more) and pick's lower-only drill cap. The reading comes from the kit's usage cache when fresh (usage numbers only; ak usage is the only command that always reads live). Exit 0 for every reading; the verdict is here, not in the exit code. Never contains a secret value. Consumers check `schema` and `interface` first; additional keys may appear in later minor versions.

kind.description: The kind or CLI asked for (with --self: from AGENTKIT_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, else the CLI of AGENTKIT_ACTIVE_PROFILE).

cli.description: The usage row's owner: a CLI (claude, codex, ...) or a provider id (zai for the glm kinds).

verdict.description: critical: rate_limited or headroom <= thresholds.critical; low: headroom <= thresholds.low; ok: above; unknown: no readable headroom (a cap at or below the low threshold may still mark it low or critical).

headroom_pct.description: pick's headroom, after the cap; null when unknown.

resets_at.description: When the binding window resets (ISO-8601 UTC).

reason.description: Why the account has no usable room or no reading; one line.

age_s.description: Age of a cached reading in seconds; 0 when live.

leases.description: Active leases on this account (ak lease).

cache_note.const: the usage cache holds usage numbers only; ak usage is the only command that always reads live
